title: GetIPListResponse
description: GetIPListResponse returns IP list configuration without CIDR entries.

contentHash.description: Unique SHA-256 hex fingerprint used to verify the stored IP list content.

labels.description:
Labels represent user-defined metadata as key-value pairs.
Label count should not exceed 64 per IP list.

**Key Formatting Rules:**
Length: 1-63 characters.
Characters: Must begin and end with [a-zA-Z0-9]. May contain dashes (-), underscores (_), dots (.), and alphanumerics in between.
Keys starting with 'stackit-' are system-reserved; users MUST NOT manage them.

**Value Formatting Rules:**
Length: 0-63 characters (empty string explicitly allowed).
Characters (for non-empty values): Must begin and end with [a-zA-Z0-9]. May contain dashes (-), underscores (_), dots (.), and alphanumerics in between.

numberOfIps.description: Number of IPv4 CIDR entries stored in the list.

usage.description: Current use of this IP list in load balancers.

IPListUsage.description: IPListUsage describes which NLB/ALB currently reference an IP list.

count.description: Number of load balancers currently using this IP list.

items.description: List of load balancers that reference this IP list.
